text: BAM share fell 0.16 percentage points over 26 hours to 34.1%, while the 7-day move remains up 1.26 percentage points. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.5% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The frequent top-node changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; fra remains the busiest region with 103 validators on its busiest node.
